kaiserkram.manager.title: Kaiserkram Features
kaiserkram.manager.menuHint: Turn Kaiserkram's features on or off for this world. Every feature is off until you enable it.
kaiserkram.manager.intro: Every feature is off until you tick it. A disabled feature registers nothing: no settings, hooks, keybindings or sheets. Changes apply after a reload.
kaiserkram.manager.legacyActive: The old module "{module}" is still active. Disable it before enabling this.
kaiserkram.manager.reloadBody: Kaiserkram features changed. Reload now to apply them?
kaiserkram.features.landing.name: World Landing
kaiserkram.features.landing.hint: Right-click a scene to make it the landing scene, activated whenever the world starts.
kaiserkram.features.party.name: Deploy Party
kaiserkram.features.party.hint: Drop an actor folder on the canvas to get one party marker; deploy and recall its members from the Token HUD.
kaiserkram.features.earshot.name: Within Earshot
kaiserkram.features.earshot.hint: Proximity voice chat: how loud others are follows token distance and walls. GM voice changer per actor (Assign Voice). Replaces the A/V client.
kaiserkram.features.trader.name: Trader
kaiserkram.features.trader.hint: Turns WFRP4e NPCs into shops players buy from and sell to, with haggling.
kaiserkram.conflict: Kaiserkram: "{feature}" is enabled while the old module "{module}" is still active. Disable "{module}" in Manage Modules.
kaiserkram.migration.gmOnly: Only a GM can migrate data.
kaiserkram.migration.failed: Kaiserkram: {count} part(s) of the data migration failed; see the console. It will try again on the next load.
kaiserkram.migration.done: Kaiserkram copied your data from: {features}. These features stay off until you enable them under Configure Settings → Kaiserkram → Kaiserkram Features.
kaiserkram.landing.SetNotification: {name} will now load automatically when the world starts.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.deployOnDrop.h: When enabled, dragging a folder onto the canvas deploys every actor in it right away instead of creating a party marker to deploy later. Hold Shift while dropping to use the "Shift+Drop" marker behavior below instead of the usual one.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.shiftAfterDepl: Only applies when "Deploy immediately on drop" is on and you hold Shift while dropping the folder: overrides "After deploying, the party marker should" for that one drop.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.includeSubfold: When enabled, Deploy also drops actors found in nested subfolders, not just the folder that was dragged onto the canvas.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.afterDeployBeh: After deploying, the party marker should
What happens to the party token itself once its members have been placed on the scene.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.tokenSpacing.h: Gap between deployed tokens, measured in grid squares. Lower values pack tokens tighter together.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.partyTokenSize: Width and height of the party marker created when a folder is dropped onto the canvas.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.defaultTokenIm: Artwork used for newly created party markers. Pick any image from your file system or a compendium pack.
kaiserkram.party.recall.confirmBody: Recall {count} token(s)? They will be deleted from the scene — any HP, conditions, or other changes tracked on an unlinked token will be lost.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.gmOnly: Only the GM can do that.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.folderMis: The source folder for "{name}" no longer exists.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.folderEmp: The folder "{name}" has no actors to deploy.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.markerEmp: The folder "{name}" has no actors to deploy yet — add some (or enable subfolders) before deploying this marker.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.nothingTo: Nothing from this party is currently deployed.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.markerGon: The party marker and its source folder are both gone; the deployed tokens were removed without a new marker.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.maxRange.hin: Beyond this many grid spaces (Foundry ruler units). One unit = one map cell.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.gmVoiceGloba: When enabled, the GM is always heard at full volume (no proximity). When disabled, the GM uses token proximity like everyone else.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.throughWallG: World setting (GM only). How much volume remains after a Normal sound wall. 1 = no muffling; lower = quieter through walls. Limited / Proximity / Distance scale from this.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.muteUnresolv: Mute voice when speaker token unknown

When enabled, a player whose speaking position cannot be placed on the map (no character token, etc.) is inaudible to other players; the GM still hears them. When disabled, they are heard at full volume until a token can be resolved (recommended for reliability).
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.toggleGMVoic: Toggle GM voice (global vs token proximity)
GM only: switch between global GM voice and token-based proximity.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.toggleVoiceT: While controlling a token, toggle whether your voice is positioned at that token (or clear to default). Default: Ctrl+Shift+V.
kaiserkram.earshot.VOICE.cannotPick: You can only set your voice token to a token you own.
kaiserkram.earshot.VOICE.needSelection: Select a token first (control it), then use the voice token keybinding.
kaiserkram.earshot.VOICE.saveFailed: Within Earshot: could not save voice token ({error})
kaiserkram.trader.SETTINGS.defaultMarkup: What new traders charge, as a percentage of an item's book price. 100 is book price, 120 is 20% over. Each trader can override this on the trader sheet.
kaiserkram.trader.SETTINGS.defaultSellRa: What new traders pay when players sell to them, as a percentage of book price. Each trader can override this on the trader sheet.
Traders pay from their own purse
When enabled, a trader can only buy from players with the coins in the trader's own purse. When disabled, the trader always has enough money.
kaiserkram.trader.SETTINGS.haggleEnabled: Show a Haggle button on each item for sale. Haggling is an opposed Haggle test against the trader: up to 10% off is a plain test, 20% is −10, 30% −20, 40% −30, 50% −45, 60% −55, 70% −65 and 80% −80. Win, and the player gets the discount they asked for.
kaiserkram.trader.SETTINGS.haggleRetry.n: Haggle: allow repeat attempts on the same item
kaiserkram.trader.SETTINGS.haggleRetry.h: When disabled, each character gets one haggle per item until the GM resets haggling on that trader.
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.grudgeHint: This trader charges you this much more, from a haggle in an older version.
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.noCharacter: You have no character to trade with. Ask the GM to assign you one.
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.overrideHint: Leave blank to use the trader's markup. Otherwise type a price like "1 gc 5 ss", "3s 6b" or "1/5/0".
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.forSaleHint: For sale (untick to keep the item but hide it from customers)
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.dropHintGM: Drop items from the sidebar or a compendium here to add them to the stock.
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.dropHint: Pick an item below, or drag one from your character sheet onto this window.
kaiserkram.trader.buy.title: Buy {item}
kaiserkram.trader.sell.title: Sell {item}
kaiserkram.trader.haggle.title: Haggle over {item}
kaiserkram.trader.haggle.intro: How much off do you ask for? It is an opposed Haggle test against the trader: up to 10% is a plain test, and every further 10% makes yours harder.
kaiserkram.trader.haggle.risk: Win, and you get exactly the discount you asked for on your next purchase of this item. Lose, and the price stays as it is, and this trader won't haggle over this item with you again.
kaiserkram.trader.gm.title: GM controls
kaiserkram.trader.gm.purseUnlimited: (not enforced: the trader can always pay)
kaiserkram.trader.gm.resetConfirm: Forget every haggled deal this trader has made, and let everyone haggle again?
kaiserkram.trader.chat.haggleWon: {customer} talked {trader} down by {ask}% on {item} ({rolls}). Their price: {price}.
kaiserkram.trader.chat.haggleLost: {customer} asked {trader} for {ask}% off {item}, but {trader} wouldn't budge ({rolls}). The price stays {price}.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.noCustom: Pick a character to trade with first.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.notYours: You can only trade for a character you own.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.alreadyH: {trader} won't haggle over {item} with you again.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.failed: The trade failed; see the GM's console.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.noGM: A GM needs to be online to trade.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.timeout: The GM didn't answer in time.
kaiserkram.trader.gm.showPlayersHint: Opens the shop if it is closed, then opens this window on every connected player's screen.
kaiserkram.trader.gm.noPlayers: No players are connected; they can open the shop from the chat card or the Shops button in the Actors sidebar.
kaiserkram.trader.help.title: How this works
kaiserkram.trader.help.stock: Stock: drag items from the Items sidebar, a compendium or an actor onto this window. Set each count below, or tick ∞ for unlimited stock.
kaiserkram.trader.help.prices: Prices: the trader charges Markup % of each item's book price and pays Buy-back rate % for what players sell. Type a fixed price to override one item. The trader's coins live on its NPC sheet.
kaiserkram.trader.help.open: Open shop lets players in and posts an "open for business" card in chat; Close shop shuts them out again.
kaiserkram.trader.help.players: Players get in through the chat card, the Shops button at the top of the Actors sidebar, or by double-clicking the trader's token. Show to players pops the shop open on everyone's screen.
kaiserkram.trader.help.trade: Players pick the character they trade as at the top right, then buy or haggle in the Buy tab and sell in the Sell tab (or drag an item from their character sheet onto this window). Coins move automatically; a GM must be online.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.playersControl: Players can move the party marker and see from it

New party markers are backed by an actor every player owns (kept in a "Party Markers" actor folder), with vision copied from a party member's token. Players can then move the marker and see what it sees. Deploy and Recall stay GM-only. When disabled, markers have no actor and only the GM can move them.
kaiserkram.party.notifications.noMarkerA: Could not create an actor for the party marker, so only the GM can move it. See the console for details.
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.closedBanner: This shop is closed. You can look, but not trade.
kaiserkram.trader.sheet.nothingToSell: Your character has nothing this trader would buy.
kaiserkram.trader.shops.title: Shops
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.noTrader: There are no traders yet. Use Create Trader, or right-click an NPC → Make Trader.
kaiserkram.trader.notifications.noOpenSh: No shop is open right now.
kaiserkram.migration.traderSheets: Kaiserkram: {count} trader(s) now open with their normal NPC sheet. Their shop has its own window: right-click the trader in the Actors sidebar → Open Shop, or use the Shops button.
kaiserkram.landing.CurrentDefaultSceneHi: Read-only. Right-click a scene in the Scenes sidebar to change it.
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.deployLayout.h: How deployed tokens are arranged around the party marker.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.debug.name: Verbose diagnostics
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.debug.hint: Log Within Earshot's entry points to the console and show a "build active" note to the GM on load. For troubleshooting only.
kaiserkram.earshot.VOICE.assignHint: The voice is saved on the actor and applies to all of its tokens.
kaiserkram.earshot.VOICE.noActor: Within Earshot: could not find the actor for this entry.
kaiserkram.earshot.VOICE.cannotApplyProf: Within Earshot: could not apply voice profile ({error})
kaiserkram.earshot.ASSIGN.title: Assign Voice: {name}
kaiserkram.earshot.ASSIGN.presetHint: Presets load starting values into the sliders; tweak from there.
kaiserkram.earshot.ASSIGN.tuneNote: Tune the pitch to the speaker: the right shift depends on how low or high the base voice is. A deep voice needs more (up to ±5), a lighter voice less (±2–3). Go in 0.5 steps until it stops sounding artificial, then adjust Bass and Treble.
kaiserkram.earshot.ASSIGN.previewHint: Hear yourself with these settings, live as you adjust them. Always open mic: push-to-talk does not apply here. Use headphones; on speakers the mic picks the playback up again.
kaiserkram.earshot.ASSIGN.mutedHint: Players cannot hear you while this window is open.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.whisperRange: How far a whisper carries. 1.5 reaches the eight squares around the speaker; beyond it, a whispering player can't be heard. The GM always hears everyone.
kaiserkram.earshot.SETTINGS.toggleWhispe: Switch whispering on or off: while on, only those right next to you can hear you. Also in the token controls on the left.
kaiserkram.earshot.WHISPER.on: Whispering: only those right next to you can hear you.
kaiserkram.earshot.WHISPER.tool: Whisper (only those next to you hear you)
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.trading.name: Trading between characters
kaiserkram.party.SETTINGS.trading.hint: Players can offer a trade to another character or an NPC: right-click their token → Offer trade, or the Trade button on your own token's HUD. Both sides put items in and accept; the GM's client makes the swap, so a GM must be online. NPCs are answered by the GM. Takes effect after a reload.
kaiserkram.party.trade.hud: Trade (with your target, or someone nearby)
kaiserkram.party.trade.noActor: Select your token first (or have a character assigned) to trade.
kaiserkram.party.trade.noneNearby: Nobody to trade with nearby. Target a token (T) and try again.
kaiserkram.party.trade.pick: Choose who to offer a trade to.
kaiserkram.party.trade.noGM: A GM needs to be online to trade.
kaiserkram.party.trade.title: Trade with {name}
kaiserkram.party.trade.dropHint: Drag items into your offer, or click one to add it.
kaiserkram.party.trade.acceptHint: The trade happens once both sides accept. Any change resets both.
kaiserkram.party.trade.gone: One of the traders no longer exists.
kaiserkram.party.trade.changed: {actor} no longer has what they offered.
kaiserkram.party.trade.notYours: You can only trade as a character you own.
kaiserkram.party.trade.nobody: Nobody is online to answer for that character.
kaiserkram.party.trade.self: You answer for both characters; just drag the items across.
kaiserkram.party.trade.error: The trade failed; see the GM's console.
kaiserkram.party.trade.closed.failed: The trade did not go through.
kaiserkram.party.trade.closed.timeout: No answer to the trade offer.
kaiserkram.party.trade.closed.left: {by} left, so the trade was cancelled.
kaiserkram.party.trade.closed.unknown: That trade is no longer open.
kaiserkram.party.trade.tool: Trade (with your target, or someone nearby)
kaiserkram.party.trade.addOne: Click to add one, or drag into your offer
